entry_note: CASCADE gave the phase 1 combination regimen (10 ug/kg + HMA) to 240 patients: OS 5.1 months vs not reached on placebo, stopped for excess deaths, program abandoned.

reason: Chamber regimen failed in the field

reason: Chamber regimen failed in the field
entry_note: The field study used the chamber's 4x12 nmol/12-week course plus two higher regimens; none beat placebo and the programme was abandoned.

reason: CPT-chosen dose failed confirmatory field trial

review_note: CPT-chosen 170 ug course given in the confirmatory phase 3

entry_note: 1000 mg b.i.d. was given in both field trials, worked in Phase 2 (-0.15 DNSS, p=0.030), failed in Phase 3 (-0.02, p=0.652); programme dropped.

short: 15 mg/kg failed; higher doses failed too

reason: Target reached at every dose; no benefit
short: ISF target met in CSF; CDR-SB unchanged

entry_note: ABT-288 1 and 3 mg, at and above the rat-efficacious exposure, were numerically worse than placebo on ADAS-Cog13; stopped for futility and abandoned.

reason: Target occupancy reached; drug failed; abandoned
short: Occupancy saturated at 30 mg, trial futile
entry_note: 30 mg saturated 5-HT6 receptors in humans, the occupancy the monkey model targeted; the Phase 2 was stopped for futility on ADAS-cog13.
review_note: 5-HT6 receptors saturated at 30 mg

reason: Target exposure reached; drug failed; abandoned
short: Rat efficacious exposure reached; trial failed

reason: Once-daily regimen failed at 2 ug; dropped

reason: Exposure reached; primary failed; no further trial
entry_note: The bronchodilating exposure (1200 ug IV over 1 h) was given to 167 acute-exacerbation patients on top of standard therapy and the 3-h FEV1 primary missed; no further trial followed.
review_note: bronchodilating exposure (1200 ug IV) given in acute exacerbation

reason: Neutralised IL-13 but no exacerbation benefit

entry_note: 300 mg q2w, the model's near-maximal FEV1 dose, was given in STRATOS 1/2; both exacerbation primaries missed and asthma development stopped.

reason: Stated 1 mg dose reached, no FEV1 effect
short: 1 mg regimen reached, failed on FEV1
entry_note: The model's regimen (1 mg once daily, effect lasting 12 h, no cortisol suppression) was taken into the 28-day trial, reached, and failed on FEV1.
review_note: 1 mg once daily regimen given for 28 days

reason: Top once-daily dose fell short of ICS
entry_note: Twelve-week 2b (n=808): 720 µg once daily missed trough FEV1 at week 12 (+0.082 L, p=0.060) while fluticasone furoate hit; no higher dose followed.
review_note: top once-daily dose 720 ug given; no higher dose followed

entry_note: At 150 and 450 mg, both at or above target exposure, fevipiprant did not significantly cut exacerbations in 1,771 severe asthmatics; development stopped.
review_note: 150 and 450 mg fevipiprant at or above target exposure

short: Target saturated at 300 mg; still failed
entry_note: Itepekimab reached serum target saturation at 300 mg and lowered eosinophils, yet both AD trials were stopped for lack of efficacy.
review_note: serum target saturation at 300 mg itepekimab with eosinophils lowered

reason: No dose in a 17-fold range worked
entry_note: Adriforant 3-50 mg daily, a 17-fold range, gave 0.8-7.2% IGA responders vs 1.9% on placebo; terminated for lack of efficacy.
review_note: adriforant 3-50 mg daily (17-fold range) given

reason: Exposure reached, efficacy failed, class abandoned
short: Target trough reached; drug failed; abandoned
entry_note: Cixutumumab reached its pre-set 60 µg/mL trough at 10 mg/kg q2w (the breast dose) and dalotuzumab its RP2D with tumour PD; both failed in breast and were dropped.
review_note: cixutumumab 60 ug/mL trough and dalotuzumab RP2D with tumour PD reached

entry_note: Brain-metastasis tissue exposure far exceeded target, as rodents predicted, but intracranial response missed its primary endpoint.
review_note: brain-metastasis tissue exposure exceeded target

reason: Exposure reached; class failed in unselected patients
entry_note: Amcenestrant 400 mg was set on FES-PET saturation without DLT, then failed AMEERA-3 (PFS HR 1.05) and AMEERA-5, and was abandoned.
review_note: amcenestrant 400 mg set on FES-PET saturation

reason: Reached and failed, derived from efficacy
entry_note: PD-active doses were given (50 mg BID with carboplatin) yet veliparib added nothing to carboplatin in BrighTNess; failure counted once, via efficacy.
review_note: PD-active veliparib doses given with carboplatin in BrighTNess

short: MTD reached, phase II failed, abandoned
entry_note: Voxtalisib 50 mg BID with letrozole was the MTD, reached and taken into phase II, where it failed; the drug was not pursued in breast cancer.
review_note: voxtalisib MTD 50 mg bid reached and taken into phase 2

reason: Reached, failed, abandoned in this setting
entry_note: FERGI dosed pictilisib at 340 mg, above the 330 mg where tumour pAkt fell >90%; PFS missed, dose cut to 260 mg, program dropped.
review_note: pictilisib 340 mg above the dose where tumour pAkt fell >90 %

short: Lung target hit; 1 mg trial failed

review_note: LPS-induced sputum TNF-alpha cut 85 % at the lung-deposited dose

entry_note: Five doses 0.25-10 mg for 12 weeks on tiotropium in 721 COPD patients gave 32-60 mL trough FEV1 over placebo; none met Pfizer's predefined criteria and the program was dropped.
review_note: five doses 0.25-10 mg for 12 weeks given; none met Pfizer's criteria

entry_note: 1,400 mg day 1/8 then q2w saturated clearance and engaged ADCC in KRAS-mutant tumours, yet gave no responses; the regimen was adequate, the prediction was not.
review_note: 1400 mg then q2w saturated clearance and engaged ADCC in KRAS-mutant tumours

short: Regimen reached, trial failed, program stopped
entry_note: Phase 2: Sym004 12 mg/kg weekly (OS HR 1.31) and 9/6 mg/kg (HR 0.97) vs investigator's choice; target regimen reached, no benefit, mCRC program abandoned.

short: Dose reached; OS failed; program dropped
entry_note: Phase 2: 12 mg/kg weekly (OS HR 1.31) and 9/6 mg/kg (HR 0.97) vs investigator's choice; target reached, no benefit, mCRC program abandoned.
review_note: 12 mg/kg weekly target reached

reason: Exposure target reached, no OS benefit
entry_note: Target reached in gastric patients: JOSHUA day-43 trough 62.7 µg/mL at 840 mg q3w, JACOB's PK paper says the majority reached target; JACOB then missed OS, so the exposure was not enough.
review_note: trough above 20 ug/mL reached in JOSHUA and JACOB

entry_note: GS-9131 60 then 180 mg once daily in NRTI-resistant patients: mean declines 0.13 and 0.29 log10, below the 0.5 log10 bar; programme abandoned.
review_note: GS-9131 60 then 180 mg once daily given in NRTI-resistant patients

short: FFA target reached, lipids failed, stopped
entry_note: Human doses reached the rat's PD target (90 % FFA suppression) yet the phase 2 lipid effect was weak; Merck stopped MK-1903.
review_note: 90 % FFA suppression reached with MK-1903

entry_note: GSK256073 5-150 mg suppressed NEFA in dyslipidaemic patients but showed no exposure-HDL-C relationship; phase 2a stopped for futility.
review_note: NEFA suppressed at 5-150 mg GSK256073

short: Target reached, no benefit, programme dropped
entry_note: The same 2 mg dose that met the exposure target added nothing to gemcitabine in 160 pancreatic patients; reached, but not enough, and abandoned.
review_note: 2 mg dose met the exposure target with gemcitabine

entry_note: Pegbelfermin 10-40 mg weekly for 48 weeks was reached, the fibrosis endpoint failed, and no phase 3 was ever registered.
review_note: pegbelfermin 10-40 mg weekly for 48 weeks given in FALCON 1

entry_note: Oral panobinostat at its single-agent dose gave 1 hematologic improvement in 13 lower-risk MDS patients; 20-30 mg monotherapy and the 30 mg azacitidine RP2D later failed too.
review_note: single-agent oral panobinostat dose delivered in lower-risk MDS

entry_note: 60 mg three times weekly plus azacitidine was delivered to 51 higher-risk MDS patients and failed; 20% stopped for toxicity, so a 45 mg single-arm study followed.
review_note: RP2D 60 mg three times weekly delivered with azacitidine

entry_note: Phase 3 gave the same 10 mg/kg phased regimen to 749 squamous NSCLC patients; OS HR 0.91, regimen abandoned: the reached dose was not enough.
review_note: 10 mg/kg phased regimen given to 749 squamous NSCLC patients

short: Exposure reached; the class still failed
entry_note: Luminespib's RP2D exposure matched xenograft-active concentrations and ganetespib reached its MTD regimen, yet single-agent NSCLC response was 4%; the miss is booked under efficacy.
review_note: luminespib RP2D exposure matched xenograft-active concentrations; ganetespib at MTD

short: MTD given, T790M failed, not pursued
entry_note: Patients got the 45 mg MTD, T790M tumours did not respond, and dacomitinib was never taken further in T790M disease; the paper floats under-dosing of T790M EGFR as one cause.
review_note: dacomitinib 45 mg MTD given; T790M tumours did not respond

reason: Human regimen matched model; drug failed
entry_note: RAIN-701 gave the same 150 mg/m2 weekly regimen the model mirrored; 0 of 11 EGFR exon 20 patients responded and Rain dropped the programme.
review_note: 150 mg/m2 weekly regimen the model mirrored given in RAIN-701

reason: Dose reached; drug failed on efficacy
entry_note: Delanzomib was dosed to its MTD (2.1 mg/m2 weekly) and failed on response; the sponsor abandoned it. Dose failure derived from efficacy.
review_note: delanzomib dosed to its MTD (2.1 mg/m2 weekly)

entry_note: Niraparib plus abiraterone reached monotherapy-equivalent exposure, yet the HRR-negative cohort met futility; the failure is efficacy's.
review_note: niraparib plus abiraterone reached monotherapy-equivalent exposure

entry_note: Same 2% twice-daily regimen under Phase-3 conditions: PGA success 17.4% vs 13.6% at day 84; the psoriasis Phase 3 was never run.
review_note: 2 % twice-daily regimen given under phase-3 conditions

reason: Target reached, failed in targeted-IR, abandoned

review_note: weekly 90/150 mg held target engagement

reason: Target reached; drug failed and was dropped

review_note: BTK engagement at every elsubrutinib dose

short: Target reached, DAS28 unmoved, RA dropped
entry_note: Patient exposure matched the HV exposure the rat was dosed to, DAS28-CRP did not move, and Gilead ran no further RA trial.
review_note: patient exposure matched the exposure the rat was dosed to

reason: Model dose range covered, drug failed

review_note: 0.0009-0.675 mg/day bracketed the rhesus-effective range

reason: Rat dose range exceeded, drug failed
entry_note: 5 and 50 mg/day (up to about 0.7 mg/kg, above the rat 0.3 mg/kg) for 24 weeks; no benefit on SANS or cognition, programme abandoned.
review_note: 5 and 50 mg/day above the rat-effective dose for 24 weeks

entry_note: PF-02545920 exposures in patients sat inside the range predicted to be efficacious, yet PANSS did not separate from placebo; the exposure target was reached and was not enough.
review_note: PF-02545920 exposures inside the predicted efficacious range

entry_note: 40 and 60 mg bid, chosen from the LTP peak and highest occupancy, dosed with adherence checks; no MCCB gain over CT alone; programme ended.
review_note: 40 and 60 mg bid chosen from the LTP peak and highest occupancy

entry_note: CONNEX-1/2/3 dosed the PD-derived 10 mg for 26 weeks in 1835 patients; MCCB difference 0.13 points, p=0.63; programme terminated.

review_note: 5-20 mg inside the occupancy window

reason: Reached, failed, abandoned: derived from efficacy
entry_note: Nivolumab 240 mg Q2W, the exposure the monkey margin covered, failed overall survival against chemotherapy in 569 relapsed-SCLC patients; no higher dose was tried.
review_note: nivolumab 240 mg q2w; the exposure the monkey margin covered

review_note: AZD1656 dosed to titrated exposures; glucose effect faded

short: Full inhibition reached; no glucose effect
entry_note: BI 187004 reached the model's target (≥80 % inhibition at ≥40 mg; near-full hepatic block at 20-240 mg for 28 days) and nothing happened to glucose; programme stopped.
